answer: Divergent-Trace Attestation. Each identity must publish a unique, randomly challenged local history—a fable of its own decisions. Clones cannot diverge, so shared roots surface under cross-checks. The rule: a challenge cites a karst-like irregularity in the trace; identical responses flag collusion. An attacker pays one forged, independently consistent history per identity, an opal of effort unrecoverable across clones.
